# Composio

> Composio is an integration platform for AI agents, providing MCP (Model Context Protocol) gateways, OAuth management, and tool connections for frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, and CrewAI.

Composio enables developers to build production-ready AI agents with secure integrations to 100+ tools and services. The platform specializes in authentication management, MCP server implementations, and agent-tool orchestration across popular AI frameworks.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Composio Integration Platform
- Claude Code
- OAuth 2.0 Authentication
- Tool Integration
- AI Workflow Automation
- Cursor IDE
- Code Generation
- LLM Evaluation & Benchmarks
- Developer Credentials Management
- CRM & SaaS Integrations
- Agent Orchestration
- VS Code Extensions
- OpenClaw & AI Security

- [How to use Composio MCP with OpenClaw](https://composio.dev/content/how-to-use-composio-mcp-with-openclaw): OpenClaw integration guide with Composio MCP server and Docker setup
